title: Batch explicit constraint scopes while preserving complete per-scope results
context: Checking multiple explicit paths or globs previously required separate MCP calls. Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Allow hunch_check_constraints to accept either a legacy string or an array of 1–16 nonblank scopes. Remove exact duplicates and return each remaining scope’s complete result in input order, including empty results.
consequences: Multiple scopes can be checked in one MCP call.
Overlapping scopes retain their own full constraint lists, including severity ordering, rationale, and provenance.
Legacy string behavior is preserved; invalid batches are rejected entirely before scope checks.
